lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular 2D grid of high-luminance, roughly circular spots organized into approximately five horizontal rows extending posteriorly from the gill region across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of diffuse, higher-intensity pixels intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, forming distinct anchor nodes at the points of geometric intersection.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature running along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high-luminance highlights on the dorsal edge and a pronounced shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a dense and stochastic distribution of high-luminance spots that are smaller in diameter than those found on the lateral flank.
